    # Convert 1-based index to 0-based index
    s -= 1
    e -= 1
    
    # Initialize DP table
    dp = [[[float('inf')] * 2 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(1 << n)]
    dp[1 << s][s][0] = 0  # Start at chair s, small size, no time spent yet

                for j in range(n):
